jobs_meta.tier_meaning: A job tag means the vendor says the tool does this. It is not a usage claim, not a test result, and not a promise the capability is reachable through the tool's MCP server or on the gate the entry records.

tags_meta.tier_meaning: A job tag means the vendor says the tool does this. No tag on any entry has been verified by running the tool. As of 2026-09-03 exactly one entry in this directory has been bench-tested at all (01-exa, see directory/BENCH_2026-09-03.md); every other entry is untested and every tag on every entry, including that one, remains a vendor claim. The live number is counts.bench_tested in directory.json.
tags_meta.key_resolution: Keys are matched against each entry's normalized name (lowercased, parentheticals dropped, punctuation collapsed), the same normalisation tools_recount.py uses to detect cross-file duplicates. One key therefore covers every entry for the same product.

schema_law_1_risk.rule: SCHEMA law 1: an MCP claim requires a URL. These entries claim official or community but their mcp_url field contains no parseable URL.

thin_sourcing.rule: SPEC 6.3 item 8: at least two independent sources. These entries carry fewer than two source URLs.

entries.name: Model Context Protocol - official servers repo

api_gate_unknown.rule: SCHEMA law 4: api_gate is the single most useful column for a solo operator. INDEX.md already calls this the directory's biggest remaining quality problem.

docs_url_missing.rule: SPEC 3.4: docs_url is blank-legal, but it is the seed for the whole docs intel layer (phase 6b/6c).
